# coreweave_inference_hot_load (Resource)

Submit an immutable checkpoint hot-load to a deployment configured with hot_load. Creation returns after acceptance; refresh observes progress. Destroy cancels an active operation without waiting for replica updates to stop or rolling back weights. Terminal operation history remains on the server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "deployment_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "UUID of a deployment created with hot_load enabled."
}

# Upload the snapshot to the deployment's checkpoint bucket/prefix first.
# Apply submits the operation; refresh observes progress without waiting.
resource "coreweave_inference_hot_load" "full" {
  deployment_id       = var.deployment_id
  identity            = "step1"
  type                = "SNAPSHOT_TYPE_FULL"
  prompt_cache_policy = "PROMPT_CACHE_POLICY_PRESERVE"
}

# After step1 completes, a separate operation can load a delta against it:
# resource "coreweave_inference_hot_load" "incremental" {
#   deployment_id = var.deployment_id
#   identity      = "step2"
#   type          = "SNAPSHOT_TYPE_INCREMENTAL"
#   incremental_snapshot_metadata = {
#     previous_snapshot_identity = "step1"
#     compression_format         = "COMPRESSION_FORMAT_ZSTD"
#     checksum_format            = "CHECKSUM_FORMAT_ADLER32"
#   }
# }

# Destroy cancels an active operation. It does not roll back weights or wait
# for ongoing replica updates to stop. Operation history stays on the server.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_id` (String) UUID of the target deployment.
- `identity` (String) Snapshot identity within the deployment, a single path segment.
- `type` (String) Snapshot type: SNAPSHOT_TYPE_FULL or SNAPSHOT_TYPE_INCREMENTAL.

### Optional

- `incremental_snapshot_metadata` (Attributes) Required for incremental snapshots; omitted for full snapshots. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--incremental_snapshot_metadata))
- `prompt_cache_policy` (String) Prompt cache handling after the swap: PROMPT_CACHE_POLICY_PRESERVE (default) or PROMPT_CACHE_POLICY_RESET_ALL.

### Read-Only

- `canceled_at` (String) Cancellation time in RFC3339, or null.
- `conditions` (Attributes List) Detailed operation conditions and error messages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--conditions))
- `created_at` (String) Creation time in RFC3339.
- `finished_at` (String) Terminal time in RFC3339, or null while unfinished.
- `id` (String) Hot-load operation UUID.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization owning the operation.
- `snapshot_chain` (Attributes List) Resolved snapshot chain, oldest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshot_chain))
- `state` (String) Aggregate HotLoad state. Acceptance does not imply completion.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time in RFC3339.

<a id="nestedatt--incremental_snapshot_metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `incremental_snapshot_metadata`

Required:

- `checksum_format` (String) Snapshot integrity checksum: CHECKSUM_FORMAT_ADLER32.
- `compression_format` (String) Incremental snapshot compression: COMPRESSION_FORMAT_ZSTD.
- `previous_snapshot_identity` (String) Identity of the predecessor snapshot.


<a id="nestedatt--conditions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `conditions`

Read-Only:

- `last_update_time` (String) Last condition update in RFC3339.
- `message` (String) Condition details.
- `reason` (String) Machine-readable condition reason.
- `status` (String) Condition status.
- `type` (String) Condition type.


<a id="nestedatt--snapshot_chain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshot_chain`

Read-Only:

- `checksum_format` (String) Checksum format.
- `compression_format` (String) Compression format.
- `hot_load_id` (String) Operation that introduced this snapshot.
- `identity` (String) Snapshot identity.
- `type` (String) Snapshot type.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Purpose: import an existing hot-load operation into Terraform state.
# Prerequisites: Terraform, a configured CoreWeave provider, and an operation UUID.
# Usage: replace the example UUID below, then run this command from the config directory.
terraform import coreweave_inference_hot_load.full 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
